game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 8: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Imperative operations.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 13.
